title: Hengliyuan Container Loading Calculator
description: Compare 20GP, 40GP and 40HC container loads from measured cartons, with 3D views and company PDF.
features: Compare three editable container examples, payload and door limits.
Customer-measured cartons, allowed orientations, stacking, reserves and optional order counts.
Independent geometry checks, interactive 3D and company-template review PDF.
limit: Single-size loose cartons only. Heuristic results do not prove optimality, load safety, structural support or legal route payload. No pallets or mixed-SKU container solver.
